Subject: Redwood add-ons proposal & SOW for CloudNova

Hi Anya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — attached is the SOW and a short usage forecast for the observability add-ons (retention + tracing + advanced dashboards) we discussed. The SOW includes two commercial paths: a pilot-friendly month-to-month option and a 12-month committed path with a blended add-ons discount.

Highlights:
- Retention: 12-month standard; option to compress to 6 months for cost savings.
- Tracing: host-based ingestion tiering, plus an overage cap option.
- Advanced dashboards: 25 seats included in the pilot; seat-based pricing thereafter.

Can you confirm the expected retention SLA and whether procurement needs a single consolidated invoice or separate line items for DP/Addon spend? If you share the headcount that will use dashboards we can lock the seat pricing.

Next steps: I can turn this into a signature-ready SOW once we land on the concession structure you need.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0198

From: Anya Petrov <anya@cloudnova.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, CloudNova Procurement <procurement@cloudnova.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood add-ons proposal & SOW for CloudNova

Jordan — thanks for sending this quickly. A few clarifications from my side and procurement's initial asks:

1) Retention — CloudNova's security team prefers 12 months for the logs retention, but our finance team is sensitive to the delta in monthly run-rate. Can you provide the monthly unit price for 6 vs 12 months so we can show both?

2) Tracing — procurement asked whether we can switch to a per-host model with a soft cap on overage rather than pure ingestion slabs. They want predictability and a way to scale without surprise charges.

3) Advanced dashboards — product team would like 25 seats during trial; procurement is pushing for a limited included seat run for the first 3 months and then metered billing.

4) Discount — because CloudNova is evaluating multiple vendors in parallel, procurement is asking for an initial concession: either a pilot credit or a % discount on the add-ons ARR if we commit to a 12-month term. Can you propose concrete numbers?

We'd like an updated SOW by end-of-day so procurement can circulate internally.

Best,
Anya
Head of Product Partnerships
CloudNova

Kim / Ben — forwarding CloudNova's questions. They want numbers today. My initial thought: give them two clear commercial packages so procurement can choose:

Option A (Pilot-first):
- 3-month pilot, include 25 dashboard seats, full access to 12-month retention on a trial credit.
- Pilot credit: $25,000 applied to add-ons consumption.
- Tracing: per-host metered for pilot; standard slab pricing if they convert.

Option B (Committed 12-mo):
- 12-month commit for retention + tracing + dashboards.
- Add-ons discount: 8% off published add-ons list prices.
- Include onboarding and one dashboard build workshop.

Questions for you: what's the minimum discount we can offer on Option B without escalation? Is $25k pilot credit feasible or should we pull back to $15–20k? Also do we have a recommended overage cap for host-based tracing (percentage or dollar cap)?

I want to keep the message to the customer crisp — they want numbers.

Jordan

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-09-02T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: CloudNova asks — need concession options (internal)

Jordan — quick notes:

1) Pilot credit: recommend $20k instead of $25k. $20k is easier to approve at the regional quota level and still meaningful to the buyer.

2) Committed discount: 7.5% is a safe floor for add-ons when tied to a Dedicated reserved capacity commit (e.g., 2x standard GPU pool). If they only sign add-ons without Dedicated, keep discount at 5%.

3) Tracing overage cap: offer a soft cap that limits monthly overage to 30% of projected spend for the first 6 months post-pilot, then revert to standard tiers. That gives procurement predictability.

4) Dashboards: include 25 seats for first 3 months in either option; after that, $95/seat/month. Offer one free dashboard build (up to 12 hours) as onboarding.

5) Legal / procurement asks: one consolidated invoice preferred. If procurement insists on line-item separation, we can accommodate but note billing complexity.

I can draft SOW text and a DocuSign-ready SOW v2 if you want.

-Kim
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

[Internal: this keeps concessions within quota and offers a predictable cap for tracing overages. Ben, if we need margin math I can run the 7.5% vs 5% comparison.]

Anya / Procurement team — thanks for the quick response. Based on our conversation and internal alignment, here's a concise counteroffer we can sign today: 

Counteroffer (signature-ready):
- Term: 12 months (add-ons only) with an option to convert to Dedicated reserved capacity within the term.
- Discount: 7.5% off published add-ons list prices if CloudNova signs a 12-month add-ons commitment. If they also commit to a Reserved Dedicated capacity agreement, we can extend to 10% on add-ons.
- Pilot credit: $20,000 applied to add-ons consumption during the first 90 days.
- Retention: 12-month retention standard. Provide a line-item showing 6-month vs 12-month unit price to illustrate savings.
- Tracing: adopt per-host ingestion with a soft overage cap limiting monthly overage to 30% of forecasted add-ons spend for the first 6 months post-pilot (we'll include metrics-based alerts).
- Advanced dashboards: 25 seats included for the first 3 months. After that: $95/seat/month. Includes one free 12-hour dashboard onboarding workshop.
- Billing: consolidated invoice preferred; we can split line items if required by procurement (may delay billing processing by 2–3 business days).

I've attached SOW_v2_for_signature.pdf with the above baked in and a DocuSign link for easy execution: https://www.docusign.com/sign?document=CN-SOW-v2

Next steps: if procurement is comfortable with the above, circle back and I'll route the SOW for signature today. If they need the 10% uplift, we'll need a Reserved capacity LOI. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call to walk through the economics for your finance and security teams.

Thanks,
